title: What Is a Light-Year? | Space Atlas
description: A light-year measures distance, not time — how far light travels in one year. See how far that really is, and how far back in time you're looking when you see a star.
ogDescription: Pick a star and see what year its light left — a light-year is a distance, and looking far away means looking into the past.
jsonldDescription: An explanation of the light-year as a unit of distance, with an interactive tool showing how far back in time starlight left its source.
